method.traced: Task 18. Source px of hdb-3room.webp. Each room's polygon is the face of the verified wall truth (hdb-3room.drawing-walls.json, Task 16c, profile-checked) that holds its point: the centre lines polygonized with shapely and simplified by 0.5 px, so it is rough by half a wall thickness. The kitchen has no wall of its own: it is the living/kitchen face's part left of the toilet-1 / store wall line (I1 and I17: x 297 at y 181 to x 299 at y 364 and down to y 480) and above the bedroom-1 wall line y 480 (the counter run left of the store and toilet 1), and the living room is that face minus it. Both polygons are cleaned of the cut's sub-pixel slivers (buffer +-0.5 px, simplify 0.5 px).
method.points: Interior points lie on paper: the 9 x 9 px window around each reads gray 255 (minimum) on the decoded image. They were moved off labels, dimension lines and door arcs: the Task 16c truth-test points of toilets 1-3, the store, bedroom 3, the balcony and the bay sat on glyphs or lines.
method.labels: As printed. Toilet 2's TOILET is overprinted by the vertical 1900 and the replayed OCR has no token for it; toilet 3's reads TOILE (parsed as TOILET). The store, the 600 recess beside the balcony and the bay above toilet 3 carry no label.
method.open: kitchen: open onto the living room (no wall, no door; the counter line at x 297 ends at y 480 and the living room continues below). Every other room is closed by walls, doors or windows.
method.not_rooms: None inside the outline: the truth's 11 faces are all listed (plus the kitchen).
judgement_calls: Kitchen cut-out: the kitchen has no wall of its own; its polygon is the living/kitchen face of the wall truth left of the I1 / I17 line (x 297-299) and above y 480, and the living room's polygon is that face minus it. It is open onto the living room (opens_onto living) and is scored as open_in_host when it shares the living room's face.

Bay (x 938-1118, y 115-178, above toilet 3) and 600 recess (x 832-888, y 804-925, beside the balcony) are faces of the verified wall truth with label null, tagged kind 'ledge' (review M1 ruling): the recess is about 0.72 m2 (below 06 section 8.6's 1 m2 post-scale filter) and the bay an AC ledge reached only through toilet 3's window. Ledges are not habitable rooms: they are neutral in the metric (excluded from the matched count and the >= 7 target, like not_rooms).
